construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Exact envelope: schema_version=1, synthetic=true, documents={work_order: JSON text, telemetry: CSV text, inspection: labeled text}. Field definitions and types are centralized in implementation.SCHEMA.
shared_schema.output: status, schema_version, synthetic, entities, missing_fields, alerts, quality_trace, validation_note. Error output contains status=error and error.
shared_schema.spans: Zero-based end-exclusive Unicode character offsets into original document strings; quotes are included for JSON/CSV tokens.
shared_schema.missing_fields: Entity, zero-based record, field. An absent sensor record uses record=null and field=*. Null, omitted, or empty fields are missing.
shared_schema.validation: One shared layer checks typed finite numbers, timestamp timezone/order, supported physical ranges, canonical units, tolerances, entity linkage and quality decision consistency.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single extraction stage: source documents -> schema-typed fields plus source spans -> shared semantic validation -> one JSON result.

behavior.missing_data: Returns incomplete and never invents field values. Empty telemetry requires a header and is incomplete.
behavior.quality_traceability: Links inspection, work order, asset, part, inspector, timestamp, reason and measured evidence; never authorizes release. Demonstrative rules, not certification.
behavior.safety: Temperature >=90 degC or vibration >8 mm/s produces mandatory human escalation with pending_external_delivery. No actual notifications or machinery actions.
behavior.fixtures: Clearly synthetic IDs and invented maintenance log. Seeded random.Random(153) generates physically plausible telemetry in the unittest fixture.
behavior.cli: Success and incomplete outputs exit 0. File, schema and validation errors produce JSON status=error and exit 2.

test_outcomes.cli_example: passed: one JSON object, status=ok, exit 0; safety alert escalates to human
test_outcomes.cli_error_cases: passed: missing file, missing argument, invalid JSON, duplicate JSON key and invalid synthetic label produce status=error and exit 2
